Directory Structure

Collapsible directory tree showing file and symbol counts. Directories with LLM summaries show them inline.

java/6 files · 22 symbols
This Java directory contains utilities for processing BMDExpress 3 benchmark dose (BMD) analysis data, including exporters for genomics results, category analyses, and integrated projects in JSON/TSV formats. It also includes a statistical prefiltering tool that performs Williams trend tests and Dunnett's comparisons on dose-response data using the same libraries as BMDExpress itself. Together, these tools enable extracting, integrating, and analyzing BMD results across multiple project files and experimental conditions.
output/1 files · 1 symbols
The `output` directory contains a Python script that generates formatted Word documents describing a toxicogenomics interpretation pipeline. This pipeline processes gene expression data through multiple analysis stages to produce comprehensive, literature-grounded reports for scientific research or clinical applications.
pdf_text/3 files · 51 symbols
A lightweight, zero-dependency PDF parsing library that extracts semantic text from PDFs by resolving object graphs, decoding compressed streams, and applying structure tags from marked-content operators. It includes comprehensive support for ToUnicode CMaps, font encodings, and table detection, plus a lossless codec that can decompose PDFs into labeled byte spans and reconstruct them byte-perfectly.
roundtrip/6 files · 43 symbols
The roundtrip package is a domain-agnostic round-trip sync system that manages human edits to machine-generated LaTeX documents in git-backed Overleaf projects, ensuring edits persist across regeneration through sentinel anchors and override tracking. It provides locking to prevent concurrent editing, reconciliation to attribute changes to specific regions, and a git transport layer to sync content between local repositories and Overleaf. The package enables collaborative workflows where both automated systems and humans can edit the same documents without conflicts.
tests/39 files · 470 symbols
The tests directory contains the test suite for the project with pytest configuration and fixtures. conftest.py provides isolated testing infrastructure including state management (patched filesystem), a FastAPI test client, fixture data, and mocks for external dependencies like Java subprocesses, HTTP requests, and the Anthropic API. This setup enables unit and integration testing of the codebase in a controlled environment.
e2e/4 files · 18 symbols
tests/e2e contains end-to-end tests for a data pipeline system using Playwright, validating the complete flow from session loading through validation, integration, processing, and approval. It provides shared testing fixtures, debugging utilities with screenshots and manual inspection checkpoints, and smoke tests using golden session data to verify pipeline correctness.
fixtures/1 files · 0 symbols
The tests/fixtures directory is a Python package that serves as a container for test fixtures and test data. Currently, it contains only an empty `__init__.py` file, making it available as an importable package for the test suite.
integration/6 files · 45 symbols
Integration tests for a FastAPI backend system that manages chemical/BMD data workflows, covering file upload endpoints, pool validation and integration for merging multiple data sources, session lifecycle management with version control, and processing integrated data with domain model validation across multiple platforms.
unit/26 files · 396 symbols
This directory contains a comprehensive unit test suite for a scientific data processing and reporting system, covering core domain logic like BMD project schema validation, document tree structure, footnote management, and data integration, as well as output generation modules for HTML and LaTeX export, partitioning and filtering, and session persistence. The tests verify functional correctness of utility functions, schema constraints, data transformations, and file I/O operations across the codebase.

Defines the sentinel format convention for anchored editable regions in LaTeX documents, providing utilities to generate and recognize begin/end comment markers that bracket stable-keyed content blocks (ADR-0005).
roundtrip/lock.pypython1296
Implements an advisory, app-level checkout lock to prevent concurrent editing of reports, allowing only one user to hold an edit session at a time and maintaining the single-writer invariant required by the reconciler.
roundtrip/overrides.pypython2178
Manages per-region user-owned LaTeX document overrides in a JSON store, enabling captured human edits from Overleaf (or other sources) to persist across regeneration cycles with stale-content detection via SHA256 hashing.
roundtrip/reconcile.pypython2419
Reconciles two versions of report.tex to identify and attribute edited regions to nodes, implementing ADR-0005's editability policy by comparing anchored regions and recording content edits as overrides.
roundtrip/transport.pypython44517
Transport layer for syncing a generated report bundle with an Overleaf project via git, supporting both local stand-in bare repos (for offline testing) and real remotes (git-bridge URLs or GitHub repos). Provides push/pull/reconcile operations to exchange the app's generated reports with committee edits.
section_serializers.pypython1874
JSON-row serialization helpers that convert Python TableRow and IncidenceRow objects to JSON-friendly dicts for the browser, with special handling to replicate JavaScript's String(number) behavior for dose keys so Python and JavaScript representations match across the wire.
server_state.pypython602
Central module that manages shared in-memory server state (BM2 and CSV upload stores) accessed by multiple FastAPI route modules, avoiding circular imports through a single-source-of-truth pattern.
session_routes.pypython156516
Session persistence and history API endpoints that manage on-disk session state, including loading saved sessions, approving/unapproving report sections, browsing version history, restoring past versions, and computing BMD summaries from approved data.
session_store.pypython1966
Manages session persistence and version history for per-chemical data, storing approved sections as JSON files under sessions/{dtxsid}/ with optional archiving of previous versions in a timestamped history directory.
style_learning.pypython2484
Manages a global style profile that learns and persists writing style preferences by analyzing user edits to LLM-generated text, using Claude Haiku to extract rules that are merged and ranked by confidence.
table_builder_common.pypython85519
Shared utilities for NIEHS toxicology table builders, providing functions for typed footnote management, dose formatting, statistics computation/display, sidecar data handling, and BMD/BMDL display logic used across body weight, clinical pathology, organ weight, and tissue concentration tables.

Standalone QA tool that generates tables-only PDFs from session data by loading processed cache, genomics, and identity files for a given DTXSID and rendering only table content via the Typst template pipeline.
tables_to_markdown.pypython51510
